findingsFixed: Removed artifact ownership fields from project-shell artifact summaries and rendering while preserving process-local artifact references.
Added provenance ids and display labels to review version contracts and patched store/service/test scaffolding to emit them consistently.
Added durable process package-context tables plus store methods with canonical upsert and idempotent semantics.
Fixed the production-shell integration assertion to resolve the built asset from the active worktree instead of a hard-coded sibling checkout path.
findingsSurfaced: Browser-facing package member contracts still carry the legacy `versionId` name as a compatibility shim; later Epic 5 stories still need the full surface rename to `artifactVersionId`.
Review target schemas still accept legacy `REVIEW_MEMBER_UNAVAILABLE` alongside `PACKAGE_MEMBER_UNAVAILABLE` as a compatibility bridge until downstream package-review callers are fully migrated.

specDeviations: Browser-facing package member contracts still expose legacy `versionId`; Story 0 added the durable/package-context `artifactVersionId` vocabulary and deferred the surface rename to avoid wider Story 3/4 regressions.
Review target schemas still accept legacy `REVIEW_MEMBER_UNAVAILABLE` alongside `PACKAGE_MEMBER_UNAVAILABLE` as a compatibility bridge for existing package review flows.
